items.title: Cambridge Court in Kearney closed in September 2026
items.source_publication_context: Flatwater Free Press published October 13, 2026; News Channel Nebraska published September 21 and updated September 23, 2026.
items.summary: Flatwater Free Press reported on October 13 that Cambridge Court in Kearney closed in September 2026, requiring residents to relocate to other facilities or stay with family while seeking a local opening.
